identity_findings.claim: Tigchelaar assigns legacy fragments1–8 to BlockA/proposed4Q24a and later fragments9–30 to BlockB/proposed4Q24b.
identity_findings.qualification: Author's reasoned reassessment, now actually read; no fresh all-fragment physical identity adjudication. Repair-sheet alternative is discussed and judged less plausible by author.

identity_findings.claim: Fragment numbers are explicitly retained, including examples frag8 and frag27.
identity_findings.qualification: This enables a versioned editorial crosswalk, not a global safe alias4Q24=4Q24a.

identity_findings.claim: BlockA corresponds to DJD plateXXXI; BlockB to XXXII–XXXIV.
identity_findings.qualification: A plate-level target reported by consulted scholarship; DJD plates themselves not inspected.

identity_findings.claim: Within BlockA, fragment8 writing is not entirely identical to fragments1–7, although author allows same scribe.
identity_findings.qualification: Do not remove this qualification or convert a published split to independently proved hand identity.

identity_findings.claim: Figure1 is a binarized processed image of proposed4Q24a fragment1; note20 points to IAA B-368070.
identity_findings.qualification: Derivative illustration, not raw acquisition or target Lev2:8–9 word verification. IAA labels same referenced record plate1079 fragment2, so IAA and edition fragment numbers differ.
